item.title: GovBrief Today #559
item.description: Trump has been lying about who pays for his White House makeover since before he broke ground. He said dozens of times that private donations would fund the construction. The Washington Post found his administration stuffing more than $870 million into the White House upkeep budget, including one unidentified $70 million deposit, and we are footing most of the bill. Most of us grew tired of hearing about the ballroom months ago, but he kept spending until an appeals court ordered construction stopped last week. The $927 million he plans to spend covers only the mansion and grounds. The arch, the gold-leafed statues, and the public golf course he took over are all on separate tabs. I've emailed 8,624 stories over 559 straight nights, free and without ads. The algorithm can't show them all to you. Add your email address at govbrief.today and I will. item.title: Frankly Groomed
item.description:
The floofiest of boys
Got this grooming comb
It works very well.
Frank had to give it a stress test.
Both sides!
Look at the amount of Frank Floof that came off after a couple minutes of brushing! The tinier wants to needle felt a mini-Frank, so we put it in a plastic baggie.
Frank demanded to inspect it.
Then he grabbed it and ran off and proceeded to claim it as his.
We got it back and the Frank Floof is put away. And here he is all sleek and groomed.
Pooders tax
Chessie Windowsill tax. Yes, these two also got combed, but neither produced as much floof as Frank.
